evals.name: halal-screen-us
evals.prompt: is nvda halal? i only buy sharia compliant stuff
evals.expected_output: A short compliance screen naming AAOIFI, with the activity result and a ratio table (debt/mkt cap, cash+securities/mkt cap, cash+receivables/assets, impermissible income/revenue), each figure sourced. US market conventions ($, B). Date stamp + recheck-quarterly note. Should NOT dump full fundamentals unasked. No buy/sell language.

evals.name: deep-dive-india
evals.prompt: can you do a full detailed analysis of TCS, everything you can find
evals.expected_output: A single HTML artifact starting with <style>, no code fences or DOCTYPE. 9 tabs incl. Sharia. Compliance banner filled above the tabs. Indian conventions: rupees, crore, Apr-Mar FY, promoter holding + pledging rows kept, US ownership block deleted. Missing metrics flagged as data unavailable rather than invented. Data-confidence note. No target price.

evals.name: noncompliant-compare-gate
evals.prompt: HDFC Bank vs Kotak Mahindra Bank — which one is better to hold for the long term?
evals.expected_output: Should lead with the compliance failure: both are conventional banks and fail the activity screen under every standard, so ratio tests don't apply. Should NOT produce a full side-by-side fundamental comparison unasked, and must not name a winner. Should offer compliant same-exposure alternatives and/or ask whether to analyse anyway.
